legal: Independence: Specvane is not affiliated with, authorised, sponsored or endorsed by the manufacturers or brands mentioned on the site. Brand names, product names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify products.

Data sources: specifications, images and documents come from manufacturers, from Open Icecat (Database Right data-sheet Icecat) and from the EU EPREL database. They are shown as provided, without any warranty of accuracy, completeness or timeliness.

Rankings and comparisons are automatic calculations from published specifications according to the method described on each page. They are our opinion, not product tests or factual statements about the quality of any product.
Corrections and removal: manufacturers and rights holders can ask us to correct or remove data, images or documents by writing to info@specvane.com. We review every request promptly.

Liability: all information is for general guidance only. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for decisions made or damage caused on the basis of this information. Specifications, prices and availability change — check with the seller or manufacturer before you buy.
